contexts.title: Larkspur Foods renewal
contexts.purpose: Renew Larkspur's 300 seats, win the 120-seat expansion to Spokane and Boise, and hold price against Quill Analytics.

glossary_definitions.mis-pick rate: The share of orders shipped with a wrong item because a handoff note was missed. Larkspur: 5.8% in January, 3.4% in September.
glossary_definitions.Audit Pack: Add-on that extends audit log retention from 90 to 400 days and adds exportable audit reports. $18,000 a year.
glossary_definitions.volume discount: 12% off Business seats for the 120 new Spokane and Boise seats.
glossary_definitions.60-day notice: The master services terms require written notice 60 days before 30 November to change or end the agreement, so the deadline is 1 October.

personas.title: The cost-focused buyer
personas.summary: Tomás Becker in procurement: polite, numbers first, will cite Quill's $31 quote and ask for a three-year term.

personas.title: The outcome sponsor
personas.summary: Priya Raman, VP Operations: cares about the mis-pick rate and the two new sites; wants proof it keeps improving.

personas.title: The sceptical operator
personas.summary: Jun Park, warehouse systems: worried about retraining and offline reliability; asks for specifics.

contexts.title: Senior Product Designer interview
contexts.purpose: Assess Elena Voss for the Senior Product Designer role: problem framing, offline design depth, collaboration and compensation fit.
contexts.job_description: Senior Product Designer, Brightwater Flow. Own the handoff and task-tracking experience for warehouse and operations teams on tablets and phones, often offline. Six or more years of shipped B2B or operational software; accessibility on touch devices; comfortable with data. Base $148,000 to $176,000.

glossary_definitions.offline-first: Designing so the product works without a connection and syncs later, with sync states and conflicts shown to the user.
glossary_definitions.rubric: The six scored dimensions in the design interview: problem framing, offline and edge cases, accessibility, collaboration, use of data, craft.

personas.title: The detail-driven candidate
personas.summary: Elena answers with specific numbers and project names; strong on edge cases, less on business trade-offs.

personas.title: The portfolio-first candidate
personas.summary: Leads with visuals and defers questions about process; needs a nudge to explain reasoning.

personas.title: The cautious negotiator
personas.summary: Answers compensation questions with ranges and asks about equity and learning budget.

contexts.title: Q4 planning sync
contexts.purpose: Agree the Q4 plan and owners for the three risks; decide whether to protect the 78% gross-margin target.

glossary_definitions.net revenue retention: Revenue from existing customers this period as a share of the same customers a year ago, including upsell and churn. Q3: 117%.
glossary_definitions.runway: How long the company can operate at the current burn rate. About 31 months.
glossary_definitions.enterprise cycle: Days from first meeting to signed contract for Enterprise deals: 118 in Q3, target 100.

personas.title: The margin guardian
personas.summary: COO focused on keeping gross margin at 78% and on hosting costs.

personas.title: The growth advocate
personas.summary: VP Sales pushing to hire ahead of plan to shorten the enterprise cycle.

personas.title: The delivery realist
personas.summary: VP Engineering warning that the status page and 3.0 share the same people.

contexts.title: Brightwater Flow 3.0 launch stream
contexts.purpose: Host the 45-minute 3.0 launch: demo, the Marlow story, offline mode and audience questions.

glossary_definitions.handoff templates: Per-dock or per-zone checklists so every shift handoff has an owner and a status.
glossary_definitions.offline mode: Work continues without a connection; changes sync later and conflicts are shown to the user.

personas.title: The practical guest
personas.summary: Dana Whitfield: concrete, operations-minded, quotes numbers from Marlow.

personas.title: The curious viewer
personas.summary: Chat asks about price, migration and offline conflicts.

personas.title: The sceptical viewer
personas.summary: Wants proof of the 41% claim and asks about lock-in.

contexts.title: Cedarline outage follow-up
contexts.purpose: Explain the 2 October Cedarline incident to an affected customer, confirm no data was lost and agree what changes.

glossary_definitions.severity 1: An outage: error rate above 10% for more than 15 minutes. First response within 1 hour, updates every 30 minutes.
glossary_definitions.service credits: 5% of the monthly fee for each full 0.1% below the 99.9% commitment, up to 25%. Partner outages are excluded.

personas.title: The worried operations lead
personas.summary: Priya Raman: wants to know whether orders were affected and what stops a repeat.

personas.title: The contract-minded buyer
personas.summary: Tomás Becker: asks about credits and the SLA wording.

personas.title: The hands-on engineer
personas.summary: Jun Park: asks for the technical cause and the fix.
